# Love4Prompts

> The universal prompt toolkit for every AI. One search bar. Six tools. Enhance, generate, translate, and discover prompts for ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, DALL-E, Gemini & Flux. Free, no signup.

## Tools

- [Prompt Enhancer](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-enhancer): Takes any rough prompt idea and rewrites it into a detailed, structured, production-ready prompt optimized for your chosen AI model.
- [Prompt Translator](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-translator): Converts prompts between AI platforms (e.g., Midjourney → DALL-E, ChatGPT → Claude) while preserving intent and adapting syntax.
- [Prompt Maker](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-maker): Generates complete prompts from scratch based on a topic, use case, and style preferences. 3-step wizard interface.
- [Image to Prompt](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/image-to-prompt): Upload any image and get a reverse-engineered prompt that can recreate it in Midjourney, DALL-E, Flux, or Stable Diffusion.
- [Prompt to Image](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/tools/prompt-to-image): Generates images from text prompts using Pollinations AI. Real-time preview with download.
- [LinkedIn Post Generator](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/linkedin-post-generator): Creates optimized LinkedIn posts with tone, length, and CTA controls.
- [Instagram Caption Generator](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/instagram-caption-generator): Generates Instagram captions with hashtags, tone, and emoji controls.
- [Coding Prompt Generator](https://love4prompts.vercel.app/coding-prompt-generator): Creates structured coding prompts for AI assistants with language, framework, and context controls.

## Universal Bar

The homepage features a Universal Bar — a single input that auto-detects intent (enhance, translate, generate, image, social, code) and routes to the appropriate AI tool. Supports 5 AI model targets: ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, Claude, Gemini.

## Prompt Library

Curated, searchable library of free prompts across categories like marketing, coding, image generation, writing, and more. All prompts are copyable and usable instantly.

## Supported AI Models

- ChatGPT (OpenAI GPT-4o)
- Midjourney
- DALL-E 3
- Claude (Anthropic)
- Google Gemini
- Flux
- Stable Diffusion

## Technical Details

- Built with Astro 6, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- AI backend powered by Groq (Llama 3)
- Free tier: 5 uses per tool per day, no signup required
- Hosted on Vercel
